articles.title: TikTok Tells U.S. Employees to Return to Office 5 Days a Week
articles.market: New York City, NY / Los Angeles, CA
articles.narrative: TikTok has mandated a five-day-a-week return to office for its U.S. employees, impacting thousands across various locations including its Culver City headquarters and Manhattan offices. This move follows a December announcement to hybrid employees and aligns with a broader trend of companies increasing in-office presence, as evidenced by a 6% year-over-year rise in U.S. office visits in the first half of 2026. The company recently closed its Nashville office, two years after opening.
articles.market_intelligence: Return-to-office policies are gaining ground across industries, with U.S. office visits rising 6% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, achieving the narrowest gap from pre-pandemic levels. This trend has contributed to record-high office rents in cities like New York.

articles.title: Blackstone Snaps Up Ken Griffin’s 125 Worth Avenue in Palm Beach for $86M
articles.narrative: Blackstone Real Estate has acquired 125 Worth Avenue, a three-story office and retail building in Palm Beach, from billionaire Ken Griffin for $86 million in an all-cash transaction. The property, which Griffin had owned since 2023, spans approximately 50,000 square feet. Blackstone plans to renovate the building's retail and office components to enhance its alignment with the luxury retail market of Worth Avenue, a strategy consistent with the firm's global focus on high-street retail assets.

data_points.notable_features: Located on Worth Avenue, a high-scale shopping district with luxury tenants.
data_points.project_notes: Seller Ken Griffin previously acquired the property for $83 million in 2023.

articles.market_intelligence: Worth Avenue in Palm Beach is characterized by extreme supply scarcity and high demand from affluent residents, leading to soaring property valuations. Acadia Realty Trust acquired 225 Worth Avenue for $43 million, or over $4,329 per square foot, in March 2026.

articles.title: Fund Administrator Hanover Park Inks 19K-SF Deal at 387 Park Avenue South
articles.narrative: Hanover Park, an AI-driven fund administrator, is relocating its headquarters to 387 Park Avenue South in NoMad, signing a 19,269-square-foot lease for the entire 10th floor. This marks the firm's fifth office move in two years, reflecting its rapid growth. The landlord noted strong tenant interest in the property, with existing tenants expanding and new companies choosing to locate there, indicating a preference for best-in-class buildings in the Midtown South market.

data_points.address: 387 Park Avenue South, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Building features highly efficient 20,000-square-foot floor plates and is located in NoMad.

articles.market_intelligence: The average asking rent for office space in Midtown South was $85.73 per square foot in Q2 2026.

articles.title: Peachtree Recaps Ritz-Carlton Portland With $141M C-PACE Loan
articles.narrative: Ready Capital, which took full ownership of The Ritz-Carlton Portland mixed-use project after a July 2025 foreclosure, has secured a $141 million C-PACE loan from Peachtree Group for the recapitalization of the 35-story tower. The 2023-completed development includes a 251-key hotel, 131 condominium units, and 159,000 square feet of office space. The C-PACE financing was suitable due to the building's recent construction under stringent codes, making much of the project eligible for retroactive financing.

data_points.notable_features: Marriott's first Ritz-Carlton hotel in the Pacific Northwest.
data_points.project_notes: Construction commenced in 2019; Ready Capital acquired a prior construction loan valued at over $500 million through a 2022 merger with Mosaic Real Estate Investors.

articles.title: Office Furniture Manufacturer Haworth Renews 30K SF at SL Green’s 125 Park Avenue
articles.narrative: Office furniture manufacturer Haworth has renewed its 30,365-square-foot office and showroom lease at 125 Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan for another 10 years. The landlord, SL Green Realty, represented itself in the transaction, while Cushman & Wakefield represented the tenant. The building's prime location across from Grand Central Terminal and recent renovations were cited as key factors in maintaining high occupancy.

data_points.address: 125 Park Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located across the street from Grand Central Terminal; recently underwent lobby and elevator cab renovations.
data_points.project_notes: Haworth has been a tenant in the property for over a decade, previously renewing its lease in 2015.

articles.title: Partnership Begins Construction on 489-Acre Industrial Park in Gainesville, Texas
articles.narrative: A partnership between B-29 Investments and Hughes Commercial has commenced construction on Camp Howze Industrial Rail Park, a 489-acre industrial development in Gainesville, Texas. The master-planned project, strategically located along I-35 and U.S. Highway 82, is designed to accommodate up to 7 million square feet of industrial space across 14 buildings, offering flexible options for users from 50,000 to 1 million square feet, including build-to-suit facilities. BNSF Railway is also developing a direct rail connection to the park, enhancing its logistical appeal.

data_points.notable_features: Located along I-35 and U.S. Highway 82; will feature direct rail service from BNSF Railway.
data_points.project_notes: BNSF Railway is constructing a rail connection to the park, with service expected to commence in Q2 2027.

articles.title: IPA Negotiates Sale of 188-Unit Apartment Complex in Arlington
articles.narrative: Institutional Property Advisors (IPA) has negotiated the sale of Flintridge, a 188-unit apartment complex in Arlington, Texas. Apogee Capital acquired the garden-style property from an undisclosed lender. The transaction highlights continued investor interest in well-located multifamily assets in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

data_points.notable_features: Garden-style apartment complex with a pool, clubhouse, business center, and onsite laundry facilities.

articles.title: New Hope Housing Completes Affordable Seniors Housing Project in East Houston
articles.narrative: New Hope Housing has completed Avenue C, an affordable seniors housing project located in Houston's Magnolia Park. This development is one of three new affordable seniors housing projects by New Hope Housing to open in Houston within the last two years, underscoring the organization's commitment to providing much-needed housing options for seniors in the area.

articles.title: CBRE Arranges $109.5M Permanent Loan for Jersey City Apartment Building
articles.narrative: CBRE has secured a $109.5 million permanent loan for 425 Summit, a recently completed 27-story apartment building in Jersey City's Journal Square. The financing was provided by Northwestern Mutual to a joint venture between Spitzer Enterprises and Arden Group, who own the property.

articles.title: A real rarity: Sturtevant manufacturing campus a unicorn in today’s industrial market
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield | Boerke has been selected to market for sale the former Cree Lighting manufacturing campus in Sturtevant, Wisconsin. This nearly 642,000-square-foot facility on 30 acres is considered a rare offering in the Upper Midwest industrial market due to its combination of advanced manufacturing infrastructure, corporate office, engineering, and research space. The property is being offered below replacement cost, providing a faster and more cost-effective path to production for owner-occupants compared to new construction, which typically involves lengthy timelines and significant capital investment. The broker anticipates strong demand from large advanced-manufacturing owner-occupants, particularly those in energy, electrical equipment, power-generation technologies, life sciences, and medical products, as well as companies evaluating the greater Chicago market.

data_points.notable_features: Nearly 90% air-conditioned, includes 93,000 SF of corporate office space, 8,600 amps of power, an 11,700 SF clean room, backup generation, specialized production infrastructure, and distribution component with 35-foot clear heights. Located along the I-94 corridor between Milwaukee and Chicago.
data_points.project_notes: The property is being marketed well below replacement cost, offering a faster and more cost-effective path to production compared to new construction.

articles.market_intelligence: The U.S. manufacturing sector is experiencing positive momentum driven by reshoring, supply chain diversification, automation investments, and domestic capital expenditures. Vacancy statistics for Kenosha County, Racine County, and Milwaukee South industrial submarkets are distorted by five specific buildings totaling over 3.5 million square feet delivered or vacated between Q4 2022 and Q3 2024. Excluding these buildings, the underlying market is one of the tightest industrial markets in the region, tightening for two-and-a-half consecutive years. Southeast Wisconsin has become a major destination for technology and advanced-manufacturing investment, with Microsoft completing its first Mount Pleasant data center and Eli Lilly developing a $4 billion investment in Kenosha County.

articles.title: Healthcare development today is about thoughtful design and speed to market
articles.narrative: This article argues that successful healthcare real estate development in the current economic climate prioritizes flexibility, practicality, and speed over flashy architecture. The author, Dan Baumeister of Bremner Healthcare Real Estate, contends that soaring construction costs and shrinking operating margins for healthcare providers necessitate a shift in strategy. Key approaches include adaptive reuse of existing retail or office properties, designing facilities with future adaptability in mind to accommodate evolving services, and making disciplined material selections. The piece emphasizes that thoughtful design should focus on improving care and supporting long-term goals rather than unnecessary aesthetic complexity, ultimately aiming for faster project completion and financial viability.

articles.title: CBRE closes sale of 32-unit multifamily community in Mauston
articles.narrative: CBRE has facilitated the sale of Riverwood Apartments, a 32-unit multifamily community in Mauston, Wisconsin. Tripp & Associates acquired the fully occupied property from Riverwood Apartments, LLC for $3.95 million. The community, built in 1994, features a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom units with renovated interiors and a pet-friendly environment.

data_points.notable_features: Located along the Lemonweir River with direct access to the Interstate 90/94 corridor, offering renovated interiors and a pet-friendly environment.

articles.title: Hunt Midwest sells 1.5-million-square-foot retail supply center in Kansas City to Morgan Stanley
articles.narrative: Hunt Midwest has sold the 1.5 million-square-foot Ace Hardware retail supply center, located within the KCI 29 Logistics Park in Kansas City, Missouri, to Morgan Stanley Investment Management. This acquisition aligns with Morgan Stanley's strategy to invest in mission-critical, net-leased real estate with strong tenant credit and institutional quality. The facility, which opened in 2025, serves as Ace Hardware's largest retail support center and is the largest distribution center in Kansas City by building footprint, underscoring the strategic importance of the KCI 29 Logistics Park as a premier destination for large-scale industrial development in the central U.S.

data_points.notable_features: Largest distribution center in Kansas City by building footprint, measuring a half mile from end to end. Located within KCI 29 Logistics Park, a 3,300-acre shovel-ready site with immediate access to Interstates 29 and 435, adjacent to Kansas City International Airport.
data_points.project_notes: The facility is a build-to-suit for Ace Hardware and was honored with a 2026 Capstone Award by the Kansas City Business Journal.

people.name: David Gross
people.title: Managing Director at Morgan Stanley Real Estate Investing

articles.market_intelligence: KCI 29 Logistics Park is a 3,300-acre shovel-ready location that can support up to 20 million square feet of industrial facilities. The park offers 20-year tax certainty and approved master planned district zoning.

articles.title: BWE originates $69.13 million of loans for multifamily properties in Indiana, Alabama
articles.narrative: BWE originated three loans totaling $69.13 million for a longtime client to finance the acquisition of two new multifamily properties and refinance an existing asset. The financing included two cash-out refinance loans on the borrower's existing Indiana properties, which generated equity for the new acquisitions, and one acquisition loan for a multifamily property in southern Alabama. The BWE team coordinated the complex, multi-faceted transaction, closing all three loans within 33 days to meet critical purchase contract deadlines and provide the borrower with flexible prepayment options.

data_points.project_notes: The loans included a $21.38 million acquisition loan for a multifamily property in southern Alabama, a $33.75 million cash-out refinance for a multifamily property in southern Indiana, and a $14 million cash-out refinance for a multifamily property in central Indiana.

articles.title: AV Management Nabs SoHo Mixed-Use for $43M
articles.narrative: AV Management has acquired 73-75 Sullivan St., a newly constructed mixed-use property in Manhattan's SoHo neighborhood, for $43.333 million. The property features 11 residential units and ground-floor commercial space. The sale highlights robust investor demand for high-quality, free-market multifamily assets in prime Manhattan locations, reflecting the enduring strength of the city's investment market.

data_points.address: 73-75 Sullivan St., New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Fully free-market residential units; ground-floor commercial space anchored by The Montessori School; immediate access to multiple subway lines (C, E, 1, 6 trains).

articles.title: U.S. Multifamily Gains Momentum in Q2 2026 as Absorption Surges
articles.narrative: The U.S. multifamily market experienced significant momentum in Q2 2026, driven by a surge in apartment demand and a moderation in new construction. Net absorption nearly doubled the previous quarter's figures, leading to a notable decline in the national vacancy rate. This positive shift, coupled with easing supply growth, positions the multifamily sector for a strong rent recovery, according to CBRE.
articles.market_intelligence: The national multifamily vacancy rate of 4.3% in Q2 2026 is below its long-term average of approximately 5.0%. New supply growth decreased by 14% year-over-year in Q2 2026. Average monthly rent increased 0.5% year-over-year and 1.5% quarter-over-quarter. Multifamily investment volume was down 2.7% from a year earlier.

articles.title: Institutional Investor Snares San Dimas Light Industrial Park
articles.narrative: An institutional investor has acquired the San Dimas Commerce Center, a 19-building light industrial park in San Dimas, CA, for $41 million. The property, spanning 179,345 square feet across 10.54 acres, was 90% occupied at the time of sale with a diverse tenant mix of over 70 local and regional businesses. The sale highlights the strong demand from institutional investors for infill small-bay industrial product, which offers both diversified income and future flexibility to sell individual buildings to owner-users.

data_points.address: 410-490 W. Arrow Hwy., San Dimas, CA
data_points.notable_features: 19-building light industrial park with a diversified income from a broad tenant base and long-term flexibility to sell individual buildings to owner-users.

articles.title: Morris Heights Seniors Housing Project Secures Permits
articles.narrative: Permits have been approved for the Morris Heights Seniors Housing Project, a 10-story affordable senior housing development in the Bronx. Developed by Crown Holdings in partnership with The Community Builders, the project will offer 95 Affordable Independent Residences for Seniors (AIRS) and contribute to a broader neighborhood regeneration initiative. The development is designed to address the significant demand for affordable housing in the borough, incorporating Passive House design standards and an all-electric system with a rooftop solar array.

data_points.address: 105 W. Tremont Ave., New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Passive House design standards, all-electric building with an 1,800-square-foot rooftop solar array, and onsite amenities including community spaces, an outdoor patio, and consultation rooms.
data_points.project_notes: Part of a broader neighborhood regeneration initiative in Morris Heights.

articles.title: Fully Leased Chula Vista Retail Fetches $30M
articles.narrative: JLL Capital Markets has arranged the $30.4 million sale of Terra Nova Plaza, a fully leased, 96,114-square-foot retail property in Chula Vista, CA. The property, part of a larger regional shopping center, was sold by a global investment manager. The transaction was compelling due to its long-term lease security, excellent freeway visibility, and proximity to a growing residential corridor, reflecting strong retail fundamentals in Chula Vista with limited new supply and sustained tenant demand for high-traffic locations.

data_points.address: 390 E H St., Chula Vista, CA
data_points.notable_features: Located within a 301,000-square-foot regional shopping center, fully leased with long-term leases, and offers exceptional freeway visibility.

articles.market_intelligence: Chula Vista's retail market exhibits strong fundamentals, characterized by limited new supply and consistent demand from quality tenants seeking high-traffic locations.

articles.title: Vornado, Related's Google-Anchored Office Building Faces 'Imminent Default'
articles.narrative: The Chelsea office building, co-owned by Vornado Realty Trust and Related Companies, is facing an imminent default on its $625 million debt, which is set to mature in December. This situation highlights the ongoing challenges in the office market, particularly for properties with significant debt obligations nearing their maturity.

articles.title: Data Center Owners Set Ambitious Climate Targets. Emissions Are Skyrocketing Instead
articles.narrative: Major data center owners and operators are failing to meet their stated carbon reduction targets, primarily due to the surging demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. The rapid expansion of AI-driven operations is causing a significant increase in emissions, counteracting efforts to achieve climate goals within the industry.

articles.title: Pet Food Company Inks 216K SF Cold Storage Lease: The Philadelphia Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: A pet food company has secured a significant cold storage lease for 216,000 square feet in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. This transaction is expected to enhance the company's operational capabilities and support its continued growth.

articles.title: Halo Vista Developers In Phoenix Reveal Plans To Attract TSMC Suppliers
articles.narrative: Developers in Phoenix have announced new industrial projects aimed at attracting suppliers for TSMC, a major semiconductor manufacturer. This strategic move is intended to bolster the local high-tech ecosystem and support the growing presence of semiconductor manufacturing in the region.

articles.title: Flex Retail Is 'Hottest Asset' In Triangle Region, Developers Say
articles.narrative: Flex retail spaces, which combine traditional retail with industrial uses, are experiencing significant growth and demand in the Triangle region, creating unique shopping experiences. Developers are increasingly focusing on this hybrid asset class due to its versatility and appeal to a diverse range of businesses.

data_points.notable_features: Hybrid retail and industrial use spaces.
